CLEVELAND and DALLAS, September 2, 2026 – Align Capital Partners (“ACP”) is pleased to announce the acquisition of Trident Solution s (“Trident” or the “Company”), a manufacturer of branded safety marking, identification and damage prevention solutions serving over 1,700 customers across utility, commercial and industrial end markets. Trident will continue to be led by CEO Blair Cook and the existing management team as the Company enters its next chapter in partnership with ACP.

Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Trident provides a comprehensive portfolio of products used to locate and protect critical infrastructure and assets. The Company’s solutions include tracer wire, markers, signs & tags, custom marking posts, stake flags, labels and engineered film products that help customers increase safety, maintain regulatory compliance and prevent costly infrastructure damage.

“Trident embodies the qualities we look for in a platform investment at ACP, including a talented leadership team, a strong market position and multiple avenues for continued growth,” said Chris Jones, Co-Founder and Managing Partner at ACP. “The Company operates in attractive end markets supported by powerful long-term tailwinds, including infrastructure investment, utility modernization, fiber deployment and increasing safety requirements.”

ACP shares that ambition, and I look forward to partnering with their team as we take Trident into its next phase of growth.”

The Company’s acquisition strategy will focus on expanding its geographic footprint, enhancing its manufacturing capabilities and broadening its portfolio of solutions to address increasingly complex customer challenges. CLEVELAND and DALLAS, September 3, 2026 – Align Capital Partners’ (“ACP”) portfolio company Marco Sealing Solutions (“Marco” or the “Company”) announced the recent acquisition of Global O-Ring and Seal (“Global”), a Houston-based distributor of sealing products serving industrial distributors worldwide. The acquisition adds a strategic Houston location to Marco’s growing footprint and strengthens its wholesale distribution and quick-ship capabilities.

Global has built a reputation as a trusted distributor for the industrial supply chain, stocking more than 125 million O-rings across nearly every major compound out of its 52,000-square-foot distribution facility. An ISO 9001-certified organization, Global is known for its extensive inventory, same-day shipping, excellent customer service and deep product expertise.

“Global’s reputation for service and quality is well-established in our industry, making for an ideal fit with Marco,” said Chad Smith, CEO of Marco. “Brian and his family have built an impressive business and team, and we are thrilled to combine efforts to provide a truly differentiated offering and suite of services to our customers. Global’s location in Houston complements our other locations as well, allowing us to better serve customers across North America.”

The two companies have complementary strengths: Marco has built its reputation on deep OEM engineering relationships and custom material development, while Global has built one of the largest wholesale distribution networks in the industry. Both companies offer rapid service and inventory depth, and together, the combined organization offers a broader range of capabilities across a wider set of customers and industries.

“This is the right next chapter for Global and our team,” said Brian DeSpain, owner of Global O-Ring and Seal. “Marco is a customer-first business, sharing the same DNA from which we built Global. Joining them gives our team and our customers access to a bigger platform and more resources, while keeping the people, the service and the Houston operation our customers already rely on.”

This transaction marks the tenth acquisition since Marco partnered with ACP and the latest milestone in its growth strategy following its additions of Pride Seals and Rocket Seals earlier this year. Chris Jones, Matt Bowen, Brad Mundt and Andrew Ameen worked alongside Marco management on the transaction.

CLEVELAND and DALLAS, September 9, 2026 – Align Capital Partners’ (“ACP”) environmental control platform MKB Company (the “Company” or “MKB”) announced today the acquisition of Siltworm, an Indiana-based manufacturer of erosion and sediment control products. The acquisition expands MKB’s product capabilities and strengthens its ability to offer customers effective, sustainable solutions supported by a growing national manufacturing and distribution network.

Siltworm specializes in proprietary rolled filter products designed to control sediment and reduce erosion across a variety of applications, including perimeter control, inlet protection, stockpile protection, ditch maintenance and slope interruption. Its products feature a lightweight, biodegradable fill material and are designed to be easy to install, cost-effective and environmentally responsible.

“Siltworm is a natural fit for MKB as we continue to expand our product offerings and invest in innovative solutions that help our customers achieve better environmental outcomes,” said Rick Costello, CEO of MKB Company. “The Siltworm team has built a differentiated product, a strong customer following and a reputation for innovation and service.”

The addition of Siltworm complements MKB’s broad portfolio of products. Together, the companies will provide customers with a more complete product lineup, expanded technical expertise, reliable supply and greater access to sustainable erosion control solutions. Siltworm founder Joe Moore will remain with the business as MKB’s Vice President, Market Development, bringing his technical expertise and longstanding industry relationships to support customer education, product growth and market expansion.

This transaction marks the sixth acquisition since MKB partnered with ACP in November 2024. MKB will continue its acquisition strategy of partnering with leading companies across the stormwater and erosion control industry. The ACP deal team of Matt Beesley, Chris Jones, Ross Fuller, Joe Vitale, Andrew Foster and Ryan Schmidt worked alongside management on the transaction.

CLEVELAND and DALLAS, October 7, 2026 – Align Capital Partners’ (“ACP”) national insurance investigative services platform Advantage Investigations (“Advantage” or the “Company”) recently completed the acquisition of NorStar Investigations (“NorStar”). This partnership brings together two established investigative organizations with a shared commitment to delivering exceptional service, reliable results and deep industry expertise.

Based in Fishkill, New York, NorStar provides surveillance, background checks, insurance fraud, insurance claim and legal investigations. The business primarily serves general liability insurance carriers, third-party administrators and law firms throughout New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The NorStar team will continue handling assignments and serving clients with the same professionalism, responsiveness and quality clients have come to expect.

“The acquisition enhances NorStar’s value proposition by providing access to the expanded national resources, technology and operational support of Advantage Investigations,” said NorStar Founder Bill Troiano. “We’re excited about the future as our team joins forces with Advantage to offer clients continuity with the same experienced personnel and investigative resources that have supported their results for years.”

“NorStar strengthens our presence in an important market and brings longstanding client relationships that complement Advantage’s existing capabilities,” said Advantage CEO Shelly Kummings. “We are pleased to have the NorStar team as part of Advantage and are committed to providing additional resources to support its clients.”

This marks the second add-on for Advantage since partnering with ACP in late 2025 and the Company’s sixth overall. Looking ahead, strategic acquisitions will remain an important component of Advantage’s growth strategy, with a focus on expanding capabilities, service offerings and geographic reach. Goldner Hawn is pleased to announce that it has recapitalized, in partnership with management, International Filtration Services (“IFS” or the “Company”), a leading value-added distributor of industrial filtration solutions.

IFS provides high-performance filtration products and services to industrial, healthcare, and commercial customers across North America. The Company’s offerings include air, liquid, hydraulic, and specialty filtration products drawn from a global supplier network, complemented by value-added services including custom filtration design, on-site technical support and maintenance, filter customization, and inventory management. IFS supports customers with complete filtration solutions that help them meet health, safety, and regulatory requirements, protect critical equipment, prevent costly downtime, and lower total cost of ownership. Since its founding, IFS has established a strong reputation driven by technical expertise, high-touch services, and long-tenured customer relationships.

“We are excited to partner with the IFS team and support the Company’s next phase of growth,” said Chad Cornell, Partner at Goldner Hawn. “We appreciate the values and vision of our new partners and are excited about the future of the Company. IFS has built an impressive platform in the filtration industry, and we look forward to working alongside management to expand its capabilities, scale operations, and continue delivering exceptional value to customers.”

“Goldner Hawn’s partnership approach and sector expertise make them an ideal partner for our next stage of growth,” said Bob Mullins, President at IFS. “This investment will allow us to accelerate our growth strategy, enhance our offerings, invest in our people, and continue expanding our presence into new customers and geographies”

The investment will support IFS’s strategic initiatives, including geographic expansion, new services capabilities, hiring, and acquisitions.

IFS is actively seeking add-on acquisition opportunities within the filtration space across the U.S.
